data.name: Tara
data.gender_notes: Tara is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit tārā, 'star', from the root tṛ, 'to cross'. Its root is Sanskrit tārā (तारा). Tara, a Hindu and Buddhist goddess; also a star. Tara is a Sanskrit name meaning “Star; (also) a goddess”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tara expresses “Star; (also) a goddess”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit tārā, 'star', from the root tṛ, 'to cross'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tara total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_english.name: Tara

data.cultural_impact: Tara is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Star; (also) a goddess”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Tara is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Star; (also) a goddess” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Tara; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Tara is a major goddess in Hinduism, often identified with the constellation Vega, and is the goddess of stars, the night sky, and time.

historical_references.reference: Tara, a Hindu and Buddhist goddess; also a star.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
